scoring_justification: The agent reports only final numbers; recomputing the TBIPM model from scratch inside the verifier is not feasible. T0 compares submitted values against the paper's reported gold within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported transition pressure and volume collapse gold values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 of the paper: transition pressure 80.2 GPa, volume collapse 4.9%
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers for the same TBIPM model; the checker uses them as fixed reference gold.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the computed B1→B2 transition pressure and associated volume collapse for US at 0 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares transition_pressure_gpa and volume_collapse_percent against hidden reference values. It applies tolerances of ±5 GPa for pressure and ±0.5 percentage points for volume collapse.
